agent: ministers wave, reader B (the production minister)
question: What the exe does around the production minister's Lua: CAIProductionMinister::DoWork whole (0x499770, the desperation at +0x5C and CCountry::CalcDesperation), the daily BalanceProductionSliders call (for whom, how often, every argument) and the two production-screen sites, CAI.FastNormalizeByPriority, CChangeInvestmentCommand's constructors and Execute against the player's sliders, PrioritizeBuildQueue and the two convoy counters, and who places an AI country's finished unit.

addresses.name: CAIProductionMinister::DoWork
addresses.comment: **Virtual slot 10 - the production minister's tick.** Sets `+0x30 = 1`, works out the day of the month from the tick (hours since 0x29C55C0 over 24, less whole 365.0-day years, walked down the month-length table at 0x1713294 - **0-based**, the 1st is 0), and acts only when `(this->countryId (+0x38) + 5) % 24 == hours % 24`, once a game day. Then, in order: **CEU3AI::UpdateSubUnitCounts(OwnerAI)** (0x499770) - the three sub-unit count arrays the script reads; **the desperation**: only where `+0x5C < 0.0f` (the inlined constructor seeds it from the -1.0f at 0x170AC0C, and CalcDesperation never answers below nought, so that is the first run alone) **or** `dayOfMonth % 14 == 0` - the 1st, the 15th **and the 29th** of a month that has one - `+0x5C = (float)((double)(float)CCountry::CalcDesperation(country) / 1000.0)`; and then, **every day whatever the date**, the mod's Lua `ProductionMinister_Tick(this)` (Lua_ProductionMinister_Tick 0x4A2B00, invoked by LuaCallProxy_ProductionMinister_CallVoid 0x4A2A80; a luabind::error is caught by the funclet at 0x8A24B9, ReportLuaError, and the tick ends). Revised 2026-10-16: this entry and FINDINGS-ai.md had the Lua inside the 1st-and-15th gate; the `jne 0x8A2483` at 0x8A2452 skips only the desperation's recompute and lands on the Lua call. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.revises: The old comment said 'runs the main block only when +0x5C < 0.0f or dayOfMonth % 14 == 0 ... The block caches ... and calls the mod's Lua ProductionMinister_Tick'. The gate guards only the recompute of +0x5C: the failing branch of `sub esi, ecx; jne 0x8A2483` (0x8A2450) jumps straight to `call 0x8EACA0` (the Lua state) and the ProductionMinister_Tick call at 0x8A249B, so the Lua runs on every day the hour gate passes. Also: the day of the month is 0-based, so the 29th passes `% 14 == 0` too; 0x899770 is named (it is the sub-unit recount); +0x5C is the desperation (luabind's Desperation, read by GetDesperation 0x4A2250), and what makes it negative is only the constructor's -1.0.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8A22E0..0x8A24B8 read whole: the day-of-year arithmetic 0x8A2318-0x8A2356, the month walk 0x8A235D/0x8A24CA (`sub eax,[edi*4+0x1713294]; jns -> inc edi`), the sum of the earlier months 0x8A236D-0x8A23AB, dayOfMonth = dayOfYear - that sum (0x8A23F1); the hour gate 0x8A23F5-0x8A241A; `push [ebx+0x54]; call 0x899770` at 0x8A2424; `comiss 0, [ebx+0x5c]; ja 0x8A2454` (negative -> recompute); the % 14 by the 0x92492493 magic 0x8A2432-0x8A2452 whose `jne` goes to 0x8A2483, the Lua call, not to the exit at 0x8A24A8; the recompute 0x8A2454-0x8A247E (`cvtdq2ps; cvtss2sd; divsd [0x160A300] = 1000.0; cvtsd2ss`). Wrong if 0x8A2483 were past the Lua call - it is the `call 0x8EACA0` that begins it.

addresses.name: CCountry::CalcDesperation
addresses.comment:
**Lua `CCountry:CalcDesperation()`, and what the production minister caches at +0x5C.** Thousandths, never below nought:

    if (!this->at_war (+0xACC)) return 0
    total = controlled = 0
    for id in CoreProvinces (+0xD10):
        p = map province id
        if p->area is not a real area (slot 0, ReturnFalse on CNullOwnerArea) or p->owner_id (+0x330) != this: skip
        if p->area != ActingCapital(this)->area and the acting capital's area is not among p->area's neighbours (+0x34 links): skip
        total += GetProvinceWeight(p)                      (0xA6500)
        if p->controller_id (+0x338) == this: controlled += GetProvinceWeight(p)
    if total < 1: total = 1
    d = 1000 - controlled*1000*1000 / (total*1000)      (32-bit where it fits, else 64-bit; toward nought)
    if CapitalLocation(this)->controller_id != this: d += (int)floor(100.5f) = 100

So 0 at peace; at war, the share of the weighted owned cores in and beside the capital's area that the enemy holds, plus 0.1 while the true capital (+0xE20, not the acting one) is lost - up to 1.1. A country at war with no such cores answers 1.0. Two callers: CAIProductionMinister::DoWork and 0x8ACE20 in the AI strategy's rebuild; the scripts' `CalcDesperation():Get() > 0.4` tests (ai_foreign_minister.lua, country/GER.lua, ENG.lua, JAP.lua) read it through Lua. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4EE560..0x4EE6F1 (`ret 4`) read whole. at_war test 0x4EE572; the core list +0xD10 at 0x4EE57E; area slot 0 at 0x4EE5B7 (COwnerArea's slot 0 is ReturnTrue 0xA92590, CNullOwnerArea's ReturnFalse 0x592360 - vtable.py); owner test 0x4EE5BD; the acting-capital area compare 0x4EE5D3 (0x42F100 = GetActingCapitalLocation) and the neighbour-link walk 0x4EE5F3-0x4EE60B; the two weights 0x4EE61D/0x4EE633 into [ebp-4]/[ebp-8]; `cmp [ebp-4],1; jge` floor 0x4EE645-0x4EE651; the fixed divide 0x4EE658-0x4EE6A9 (0xB99AF0 multiply, 0xB99980 divide); `1000 - eax` 0x4EE6AE; GetCapitalLocation (0x417AF0) controller test 0x4EE6B9-0x4EE6CA and floorf(100.5f at 0x160A684) added 0x4EE6CC-0x4EE6E7. Wrong if CalcDesperation could go negative: controlled is summed only where total was, so the ratio never passes 1000.

addresses.name: GetProvinceWeight
addresses.comment:
**A province's weight**, the province in ESI, bare `ret`:

    if owner_id (+0x330) == 0: return 1
    w = manpower (+0x320) / 1000 + 1                         (toward nought)
    cap = GetActingCapitalLocation(owner)
    if area (+0x2B4) == cap->area or continent (+0x368) == cap->continent:
        w += modifiers[FORT_LEVEL (10)] / 1000              (+0x114, +0x50)
    else
        w = w / 5
    return max(w, 1)

Three callers: CCountry::CalcDesperation (twice) and CCountry::RebuildNeighbours at 0x4E2A62, which sums it into CCountry +0x106C. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4A6500..0x4A65D7 read whole: `cmp [esi+0x330],0; mov eax,1; je exit`; `imul [esi+0x320]` by 0x10624DD3, sar 6, plus 1 (`lea edi,[edx+eax+1]`); the owner's acting capital via the country database and 0x42F100 twice; the area compare 0x4A655E and the +0x368 compare 0x4A6590; the fort term `[[esi+0x114]+0x50]/1000` 0x4A65AA-0x4A65C4; the /5 by 0x66666667 sar 1 at 0x4A6598; `cmp edi,1; jl -> 1`. ESI is the only input: no stack argument is read and the callers set ESI (`mov esi, edi` at 0x4E2A60). Wrong if +0x50 were not FORT_LEVEL - combatmods' four-read fix of CMapProvince +0x114 says it is.

addresses.name: CAI_FastNormalizeByPriority
addresses.signature: float __cdecl CAI_FastNormalizeByPriority(lua_State* L, int level, float lendLease, float consumer, float production, float supply, float reinforce, float upgrade)
addresses.comment:
**Lua `CAI.FastNormalizeByPriority(level, ll, consumer, production, supply, reinforce, upgrade)`** - the exe's copy of the PRIO_SETTINGS loop the base game's script has commented out. With s[0..5] the six floats and order = g_SliderPrioritySettings[level] (0x11EC688, 6 ints a row, **no bounds check**):

    i = order[0]; v = (float)((double)s[i] + 0.00005)         ; the double (double)0.00005f
    if !(1.0f > v) v = 1.0f                                    ; comiss, so NaN -> 1.0
    left = (float)(1.0 - (double)v); if !(left > 0) left = 0
    s[i] = v
    for k = 1..5:
        i = order[k]; v = (float)((double)s[i] + 0.00005)
        if !((double)left > (double)v) v = left                ; v = min(v, left)
        left = (float)((double)left - (double)v); if !(left > 0) left = 0
        s[i] = v
    push s[0], s[1], .. s[5], then max(left, 0) - each lua_pushnumber((double)float)
    return 7.0f

So every share gets 0.00005 more than asked while room is left, in priority order, and the remainder is the seventh result `factor_left`. Single precision throughout, in SSE (no x87 state matters). The returned float is pushed by luabind as an eighth result, which the script ignores. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x8E9250..0x8E9552 read whole (bare `ret`, cdecl; luabind.json registers 0x8E9250 as CAI.FastNormalizeByPriority with signature (lua_State*, SLIDER_AUTOMATION_LEVEL, float x6)). Row address `[level*0x18 + 0x15EC688 + 4k]` (0x8E9289-0x8E92A6); constants: 0x160A3D8 = 4.999999873689376e-05 (double), 0x171DBAC = 1.0f (564 loads in .text, no store - byte scan for movss/mov/fstp stores with a positive control of the same filter), 0x160A248 = 1.0 (double), 0x160A3D0 = 7.0f. Seven lua_pushnumber ([0xD2B4C0], pefile) 0x8E94BC-0x8E9542, the last after `comiss xmm0, 0; ja`. Wrong if a step clamped against the cap rather than `left` after the first - 0x8E932B compares xmm5 (left) with xmm4 (v).

addresses.name: g_SliderPrioritySettings
addresses.no_signature: data: five rows of six ints
addresses.comment:
**The PRIO_SETTINGS table** CAI_FastNormalizeByPriority walks: one row per SLIDER_AUTOMATION_LEVEL, six share indices (0 lend-lease, 1 consumer goods, 2 production, 3 supply, 4 reinforcement, 5 upgrade) in the order they are served:

    0 (the AI)               1 0 3 4 2 5   consumer, lend-lease, supply, reinforce, production, upgrade
    1 Prioritize Production  0 1 3 2 4 5   lend-lease, consumer, supply, production, reinforce, upgrade
    2 Prioritize Upgrades    0 1 3 5 4 2   lend-lease, consumer, supply, upgrade, reinforce, production
    3 Prioritize Reinf.      0 1 3 4 2 5   lend-lease, consumer, supply, reinforce, production, upgrade
    4 (reinforcement bonus)  0 4 1 3 2 5   lend-lease, reinforce, consumer, supply, production, upgrade

In .rdata and hard-coded: no define or file reaches it, which is what the script's comment means by 'if you mod that you cant use this function'. The rows after 4 are string bytes. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Read with image.read(0x15EC688 + level*0x18, 0x18): rows 0-4 as above, row 5 onward ASCII. Referenced only through the scaled index in 0x8E92A6..0x8E9441 (findRefs finds no direct reference, the base being folded into `[eax+eax+0x15EC688]` and its +4..+0x14 neighbours). The level names are the AUTOMATE_* keys GetSliderAutomationText (0x4053C0) gives 1..3.

addresses.name: CChangeInvestmentCommand::CChangeInvestmentCommand
addresses.signature: CChangeInvestmentCommand* __stdcall CChangeInvestmentCommand::CChangeInvestmentCommand(CChangeInvestmentCommand* this, float lendLease, float consumer, float production, float supply, float reinforce, float upgrade, CCountryTag country) @EAX
addresses.comment:
**The Lua constructor's body** - `CChangeInvestmentCommand(tag, ll, consumer, production, supply, reinforce, upgrade)` reaches it through the luabind wrapper 0x989590, which passes the six floats first and the tag last. Normalises here, at construction:

    x[i] = arg[i] > 0 ? arg[i] : 0                         ; comiss, so NaN -> 0
    sum  = (float)((((((double)x0 + x1) + x2) + x3) + x4) + x5)
    for i in 0..5:
        f = (float)((double)x[i] / (double)sum)
        shares.push_back( (__int64)(f * 32768.0 + (f < 0 ? -0.5 : 0.5)) )   ; x87, _ftol2: toward nought

so each share is the float fraction in 15-bit fixed point **rounded half away from nought**, and the six need not sum to exactly 32768. A sum of nought gives 0/0 and _ftol2's integer indefinite. Fields: +0x3C/+0x40 the country, +0x44..+0x4C the vector of six 48.15 shares. `ret 0x24`. The x87 step runs on the thread the Lua runs on - the main thread for both callers, at 24-bit precision, where f * 32768 + 0.5 is exact but for a one-unit tie. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x5569B0..0x556D11 (`ret 0x24`) read whole: the six clamps 0x556A45-0x556AAE, the double sum 0x556AB3-0x556AE0, then six times divsd, cvtpd2ps/cvtsd2ss, `comiss [0x15BED10] = 0.0f; jb` choosing 0x160A308 = 0.5 or 0x160A350 = -0.5, `fld; fmul [0x160A348] = 32768.0; fadd; call 0xC088A6` (_ftol2, edx:eax) and push_back 0x422690. One caller, 0x98963B, inside the luabind constructor wrapper 0x989590 (`push [ebp+0x28]; push [ebp+0x24]` the tag, six movss from [ebp+0xC]..[ebp+0x20]). The 20 April 1936 save bears out the rounding: Sweden's `distribution` 0.00006 0.00006 0.35846 0.27975 0.00320 0.35846 is 2+2+11746+9167+105+11746 = 32768 in 32768ths, and an empty share given 0.00005 comes out 2 (1.64 rounded), where truncation would give 1.

addresses.name: CChangeInvestmentCommand::CChangeInvestmentCommand_shares
addresses.signature: CChangeInvestmentCommand* __stdcall CChangeInvestmentCommand::CChangeInvestmentCommand_shares(CChangeInvestmentCommand* this, void* shares, CCountryTag country) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The production screen's constructor**, from CProductionView::SendDistribution: takes a vector of 48.15 shares, **sets every negative one to nought in the caller's vector**, sums them in 64 bits and stores each as `(share << 15) / sum` - __alldiv, toward nought - so the player's six are truncated where the Lua's are rounded, and sum to 32768 or a little under. A sum of nought divides by nought. `ret 0x10`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x556760..0x556875 and the push_back loop to 0x55699B: the CCommand head and vftable 0x15C4034, country from [ebp+0x10]/[ebp+0x14]; the clamp-and-sum loop 0x556812-0x55684D (`jg/jl/jae` on the high and low dwords, `mov 0` into [eax+ecx*8]); per entry `shld eax,edx,0xf; shl edx,0xf; push sum; call 0xB99980` (the 64-bit divide, trap 7) then the vector append. One caller, 0x7FFCE2 in CProductionView::SendDistribution.

No clamp, no normalising, no cost, no message, no test of who sends it - the country is the database's entry at the command's id (+0x40). Its slot 14 is ReturnTrue: nothing refuses it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.

addresses.name: CProductionView::SendDistribution
addresses.comment: **What the production screen sends when a slider has moved** (CProductionView::Update, at most once a wall-clock second, and 0x7FFA80). Nothing while the local player has delegated production (`GetLocalPlayer()->automation[1] == 1`). Otherwise, for each slider of the view's list (+0xB8) in order: `v` = its `actual_slider` value (an amount of IC), `f = (float)((double)v / (double)view->totalIC (+0xC8, the float of TotalIC))`, `s = (__int64)(f * 32768 +- 0.5)` (x87, half away from nought), the running total held at 100.0 (0x320000) - which six fractions never reach - and s appended; then a CChangeInvestmentCommand_shares with the view's country, which zeroes negatives and divides each by the sum toward nought, posted through the session (+0xB0 slot 18 -> +0x38 slot 6). `ret 4`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::DeployFinishedUnits
addresses.comment:
**Who places a finished unit of a country the AI runs.** Called from ProcessAI: at 0x889AD0 for every country whose units the AI runs, **once a day at the hour (id + 8) mod 24** (the planning slot is id mod 24, the third id + 16); and at 0x88979F, **every hour**, for the played country while `GetLocalPlayer()->automation[6] == 1`. On a TBB worker, as ProcessAI is. Walks the country's deployments (+0x688) in order, unit deployments only (slot 8 0x4B4, a unit with a first brigade); def = that brigade's definition:

- **a deployment of one brigade, ship or wing** first looks for a unit to join: of the country's own units (no expeditionary owner) that suit it - air to air (an air group only to a unit based on a carrier with room, anything else not to a carrier's or an air group's unit), a ship to a fleet (not a warship to a transport fleet; a submarine only to an all-submarine fleet), a brigade to a land unit whose army_role (CArmy +0x2FC) takes the brigade's role (SubUnitDefinition_GetRole: role 0 never; 1, 2 and above 8 anything; 3 takes 3 at x0.5 and 4 at x3; 4 takes 4 at x0.5 and 3 at x3; 5-8 only its own) - and holds no more than 3 (land, with at most one narrow brigade and a full line of 3 wide taking only a zero-width one) or 2 (air, but for an air group), counting what this pass has already sent each unit; score = brigades x 10 x that factor - plan_subunit_difference[type] (CUnit +0x5C); **the lowest under 100000 wins, the first of equals**, and it must be one the deployment may be placed beside (slot 10, CanDeployIn on the unit's province - so in the acting capital's area). Posted: CDeployUnitCommand(unit's province, deployment, unit) - a join.
- **otherwise, and for every larger unit**: a non-air-group unit goes to the province of the acting capital's area with the highest `LOCAL_IC/1000 + 2*trunc(FORT/1000) + 2*trunc(COASTAL_FORT/1000)` (+10 for the acting capital itself; strictly higher wins, from -1; CanDeployIn must hold - a naval base for a fleet, an air base for an air unit), with no target; **for the played country only**, also a CAttachUnitCommand to the HQ of that province's theatre (CMapProvince +0x380/+0x384). An air group goes to the province of the first fleet that has a carrier (carrier_size > 0) with no group aboard (+0xE4).

A unit nothing suits stays waiting and is tried again next day. Building deployments are left alone. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x88B300..0x88BE7B (`ret 4`) read in its branches; decompiled for the shape. The deployment loop and kind test 0x88B3A2-0x88B3EF; `cmp [unit+0x40],1; jne 0x88B8BE` 0x88B3F8; the land role switch 0x88B5C7-0x88B642 with its jump table at 0x88BEC8 (0x88B77D, 0x88B647 x2, 0x88B622, 0x88B60E, 0x88B604 x4) and the factors 0x171DC88 = 3.0f, 0x15AB304 = 0.5f; the counts 0x88B647-0x88B688 (two std::maps of this pass's additions, 0x474A30, plus the unit's own brigades split at width 1000); the caps 0x88B69D-0x88B6E8; the score 0x88B6EE-0x88B744 (10.0 at 0x160A340, the vector at +0x5C indexed by type_index +0x24); `comisd best, score; jbe` and slot `[edx+0x28]` with the unit's province (+0x130) 0x88B749-0x88B778; initial best 100000.0f (0x160A500). The capital-area branch 0x88BA2E-0x88BC03: the area's province list (+0x24), [+0x114]+0x80/+0x50/+0x58 (ids 16, 10, 11 by modifierIds.json), +10.0 where +0xD0 == CCountry +0xE24, start -1.0f (0x170AC0C); the player test `cmp [edi+4], [gs+0xc34]` 0x88BD10 and CAttachUnitCommand (0x5DE890) on 0x4B09D0 of the theatre found by FindPersistentByIdPair(+0x380, +0x384). The carrier branch 0x88B8BE-0x88BA29 (`[edx+0x190] > 0`, `[ecx+0xe4] == 0`). The ProcessAI sites: 0x889784-0x88979F (`cmp [edx+0x18], 1`) and 0x889ABF-0x889AD0 (`cmp edi(hour), [esp+0x28]` = (id+8) % 24 from the idiv at 0x88995F).

addresses.name: SubUnitDefinition_GetRole
addresses.comment: A brigade type's role on the scale army_role (CArmy +0x2FC) uses: **0** radio_strength (+0x180) above 1 - a headquarters; **5** police, garrison or militia brigade; **6** bergsjaeger; **7** marine; **8** paratrooper (CSubUnitDataBase +0x4C/+0x50/+0x54, +0x40, +0x44, +0x48); **3** softness (+0x124) under g_AiAirNavalPowerBase (500) - armour; **1** width (+0xE8) under 1 - support; **4** max_speed (+0x108) of 6 or more; **2** otherwise. The def in ESI, bare `ret`. Callers: CEU3AI::DeployFinishedUnits and two in 0x8E2xxx. The name is ours; that 3 is armour and 4 fast is read off the tests, not off a label. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x5A8540..0x5A868F (several bare `ret`s, then 0x5A8690 - trap 2's known pair): `cmp [esi+0x180],0x3e8; jle` -> 0; the lazy CSubUnitDataBase; the six type compares on +0x24 against DB +0x4C/+0x50/+0x54 (5), +0x40 (6), +0x44 (7), +0x48 (8); `cmp [esi+0x124],[0x1A886AC]; jge` -> 3; `cmp [esi+0xe8],0x3e8; jge` -> 1; `cmp [esi+0x108],0x1770; setge; lea eax,[eax+eax+2]`. The DB offsets' names from project.json's CSubUnitDataBase fields; 0x1A886AC is g_AiAirNavalPowerBase (500, CRT-initialised).

addresses.name: CGameState::GetLocalPlayer
addresses.comment: `ret 4`. Walks the player list at `state+0x60`, chained on `+0x54`, matching each entry's `+0x1C` against `in_game_screen (+0xBE8)` slot 18's `+0x6C`, and falls back to `state+0x70` when nothing matches. **It answers a CHuman** (luabind's `CAI.IsAIControlledForPlayer(CHuman::AUTOMATIONTYPE)` indexes its +0x38 by that enum): +0x20 the country played, +0x2C automate_sliders (the production sliders' level, 0-3), +0x30 automate_tech_sliders (the four-way setting that seeds the tech minister's two bytes), +0x34 automate_trade, **+0x38 the seven automation flags** - the save's `ai = { ... }` - of which the minister-creation functions index the first five and ProcessAI reads [6] (automatic deployment). **Its byte `+0x28` gates every event popup**: FireEvent shows the local player an event window only while it is set, and hands the player's events to the AI under `nopopup` only while it is set; CInGameIdler slot 24 (VA 0x674EF0) likewise deletes the object it is handed instead of passing it on when the byte is clear. What sets it was not found. 115 direct callers, not two (findRefs --callers 0x685F00). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ai.md, reversing/findings/FINDINGS-eventfire.md and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md.
addresses.revises: Return type `void*` -> `CHuman*` (the struct this fragment declares), so the 115 callers' reads type; and 'the array of five AI-delegation flags' -> seven: CGameState::LoadKey's `ai` arm (0x680250) reads seven ints into it through the setter 0x68A6B0 (which takes only 0 and 1), and ProcessAI tests [6] at 0x889795. The save keys automate_sliders, automate_tech_sliders and automate_trade are not flags 0-2, as FINDINGS-ai.md inferred, but the separate fields +0x2C, +0x30 and +0x34.
addresses.evidence: LoadKey's arms resolved by token: automate_trade (1847, `cmp eax,0x737; je 0x68066F`) stores a bool at [GetLocalPlayer()+0x34] (0x680698); automate_sliders (1848) and automate_tech_sliders (1889) through the byte jump table 0x680CC0 (indices 0 and 41 -> 0x6808E9 and 0x68092E) store ints at +0x2C (0x680914) and +0x30 (0x680959); `ai` (1516, 0x680247) reads a 7-int list (`push 7` 0x68026C) into flags 0..6 via 0x68A6B0 and element 5 into +0x48 (0x6802BF). Tokens from ghidra/saveTokens.json. IsAIControlledForPlayer (0x8E9190) returns `[[GetLocalPlayer()+0x38] + type*4] == 1`. The save Germany1936_04_20_03 has `ai= { 0 0 1 0 0 7 0 }`, `automate_sliders=3`, `automate_tech_sliders=1`. Wrong if the object were not CHuman - nothing but the luabind enum's owner names it.

addresses.name: RunCountryDailyPass_BalanceProductionSliders
addresses.comment:
**The daily BalanceProductionSliders call**, last thing in RunCountryDailyPass (after the IC shares are run at 0xDB4F3 the same day, so what it posts takes effect from the next day's). For a country that is not REB, owns a province (+0xCF8 > 0), has a CEU3AI (+0x1D8), in an ordinary game (state +0xD0C clear). With h = GetLocalPlayer():

- **the AI's branch** (0x4DC24F), where h->country id (+0x24) is not this country's, **or** it is and production is delegated (h->automation[1] == 1): level = 0; lendLease = CDistributeLendLease's need over TotalIC - its slot 3 is the shared nought (0xABF870), so **always 0**; then LuaProxy_BalanceProductionSliders_CallAi, and where the country gives lend-lease to anybody (+0x6B8 vector not empty), BalanceLendLeaseSliders.
- **the player's branch**, his own country undelegated, only while h->automate_sliders (+0x2C) > 0: level = that (1-3); lendLease = **his current lend-lease share** (ProductionDistribution[0] base_percentage x 2^-15, a float, not below 0).

Both: consumer, production, supply, reinforce, upgrade = `max(0, (float)(GetNeeded(share) x 2^-15) / (float)TotalIC)` - each share's need over the country's whole IC, single precision (TotalIC 0 gives inf or NaN, which the `fcompi` lets through); hasReinforceBonus = `1000 + modifier[MODIFIER_REINFORCEMENT_BONUS (86)] > 1000`. On the thread the daily pass runs on. A luabind::error is caught (funclets 0x4DC23C, 0x4DC3E8: ReportLuaError) and the pass ends for that country. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x4DBEA8..0x4DC3E3: the REB bytes 0x4DBEA8-0x4DBEC1, `cmp [ebx+0xcf8],0; jle` 0x4DBEC7, `cmp [esi+0xd0c],edi; jne` 0x4DBF45; TotalIC `fild dword` 0x4DBF60; the five needs through `[ProductionDistribution+4..+0x14]` slot `[edx+0xc]` (3), `fmul [0x160A2E0] = 2^-15`, `fdiv [ebp-0x28]`, `fldz; fcompi; jbe` 0x4DBF63-0x4DC0AB; the bonus `[[ebx+0xda8]+0x2b0] + 0x3e8 > 0x3e8` 0x4DC0A5-0x4DC0C3 (0x2B0 = 86 x 8, modifierIds.json 86 MODIFIER_REINFORCEMENT_BONUS); GetLocalPlayer 0x4DC138, `cmp [esi+0x24], [ebx+0xca8]; jne 0x4DC24F` and `cmp [[esi+0x38]+4], 1; je 0x4DC24F`; `cmp [esi+0x2c],0; jle` 0x4DC16D; the LL share 0x4DC177-0x4DC1A7; the AI LL 0x4DC24F-0x4DC28B through slot 3 of ProductionDistribution[0] (CDistributeLendLease's table slot 3 is 0xABF870, which writes 0 to both dwords); `mov [ebp-0x2c], 0` (level) at 0x4DC2E2; the lend-lease vector test 0x4DC2F9-0x4DC30B.

The same for every country, played or not. The gate of the enclosing block was not read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.

structs.name: CHuman
structs.comment: **The local player's record** - what CGameState::GetLocalPlayer answers, one per human in the session list at CGameState +0x60 (chained on +0x54). No virtual table. The class name is luabind's: `CAI.IsAIControlledForPlayer(CHuman::AUTOMATIONTYPE)` indexes this record's +0x38 by that enum. Its automation keys are the save's top-level `automate_trade`, `automate_sliders`, `automate_tech_sliders` and `ai`. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
structs.evidence: GetLocalPlayer's walk (0x685F00) returns an entry of that list; IsAIControlledForPlayer (0x8E9190) is `[[GetLocalPlayer()+0x38] + type*4] == 1`; CGameState::LoadKey's automation arms all store through GetLocalPlayer(). No size is given: nothing here reads past +0x54.

structs.name: CChangeInvestmentCommand
structs.comment: **The command that sets a country's six production shares.** Made by the Lua (CChangeInvestmentCommand(tag, ll, consumer, production, supply, reinforce, upgrade), normalised and rounded at construction) and by the production screen (CProductionView::SendDistribution, normalised and truncated); Execute writes the shares as they stand. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md, section B.
structs.evidence: operator new(0x54) in Clone (0x556EC1) and in the luabind wrapper (0x9895D5); vftable 0x15C4034 written by all three constructors and Clone; RTTI base CCommand at offset 0.

struct_fields.name: country
struct_fields.comment: The country this human plays: the letters, the id at +0x24. RunCountryDailyPass compares +0x24 with a country's id to tell the player's own country; the production screen's arrows take GetCountry of +0x20/+0x24.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x4DC14B `cmp [esi+0x24], [ebx+0xca8]`; 0x805DB2-0x805DC1 `[eax+0x20]`, `[eax+0x24]` into a tag then 0x402610 (CCountryTag::GetCountry). CGameState::AssignHumanControllers' record already reads the same pair off the list entries.

struct_fields.name: automate_sliders
struct_fields.comment: **The production sliders' automation level** (SLIDER_AUTOMATION_LEVEL): 0 manual, 1 Prioritize Production, 2 Prioritize Upgrades, 3 Prioritize Reinforcement. Saved as `automate_sliders`. Above 0, the daily pass calls BalanceProductionSliders for the player's own country with it; the production screen's two arrows cycle it.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey token 1848 -> 0x6808E9 -> `mov [eax+0x2c], esi` at 0x680914; read at 0x4DC16D/0x4DC1C5 and written at 0x80591C/0x805D2D; GetSliderAutomationText maps 0-3.

struct_fields.name: automate_tech_sliders
struct_fields.comment: The technology screen's four-way automation setting (OPT_NORMAL, OPT_AICONTROL, TECH_AUTOMATED, LEADERSHIP_AUTOMATED), saved as `automate_tech_sliders`; it seeds the tech minister's two bytes +0x5C/+0x5D (FINDINGS-ai.md).
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey token 1889 -> 0x68092E -> `mov [eax+0x30], esi` at 0x680959. The four-way switch on GetLocalPlayer()[+0x30] in 0x889319-0x889367 is FINDINGS-ai.md's.

struct_fields.name: automate_trade
struct_fields.comment: Automate Trade, saved as `automate_trade`. RunHourlyAITrade answers the player's trade offers and runs ProposeTrades for his country while it is set.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey token 1847 (`cmp eax,0x737; je 0x68066F`) -> `mov [eax+0x34], cl` at 0x680698. RunHourlyAITrade's record already reads +0x34 as automate_trade.

struct_fields.name: automation
struct_fields.comment: **The seven automation flags**, a vector of ints indexed by CHuman::AUTOMATIONTYPE, each 0 or 1 - the save's `ai = { ... }`. [0] foreign policy, [1] production, [2] technology, [3] politics, [4] intelligence (the five ministers, FINDINGS-ai.md), [6] **automatic deployment** of finished units (ProcessAI then runs CEU3AI::DeployFinishedUnits for the played country every hour). [5] was not read; the save's 7 there is refused by the setter, which takes only 0 and 1, and kept at +0x48 instead. End of the vector at +0x3C.
struct_fields.evidence: LoadKey's `ai` arm 0x680250-0x6802B0 (seven ints through 0x68A6B0, which stores `[+0x38][i] = v` only for i < size and v <= 1); ProcessAI 0x889792-0x889795 `cmp [[eax+0x38]+0x18], 1`; RunCountryDailyPass and SendDistribution test [1]. That [6] is the production screen's `auto_deployment_checkbox` is inferred - the checkbox exists (0x7FBD32) and its handler was not read.

struct_fields.name: automation_end
struct_fields.comment: One past the last of the automation flags; the setter and LoadKey size the vector by (+0x3C - +0x38) / 4.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x68A6B7-0x68A6C3 `mov esi,[eax+0x3c]; sub esi,[eax+0x38]; sar esi,2; cmp ecx,esi`; 0x67FDF7-0x67FE01 the same.

struct_fields.name: ai_entry5
struct_fields.comment: The fifth (0-based) number of the save's `ai = { ... }` list, kept here as it stands - 7 in the 20 April 1936 save, a value the flag setter refuses. What reads it was not traced.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x6802B2-0x6802BF: `mov esi,[[esp+0x20]+0x14]` (element 5 of the parsed list) then `mov [GetLocalPlayer()+0x48], esi`.

struct_fields.name: country_tag
struct_fields.comment: The country whose shares it sets, its letters; the id half is +0x40. Saved as `country`.
struct_fields.evidence: Written by all three constructors ([ebp+0x10] in the shares form, [ebp+0x24] in the Lua form, `---` in the prototype) and copied by Clone; fieldmap.py: `country` lands at +0x3C/+0x40.

struct_fields.name: country_id
struct_fields.comment: The country's id: Execute indexes the country database with it.

struct_fields.name: shares
struct_fields.comment: Begin of a vector of six 48.15 shares in ProductionDistribution order (lend-lease, consumer goods, production, supply, reinforcement, upgrade), already normalised by whichever constructor made the command; end at +0x48, capacity at +0x4C. Saved as `data`.
struct_fields.evidence: Execute 0x556D2E-0x556D52 reads `[+0x44 + i*8]` for i < (+0x48 - +0x44)/8; both non-default constructors push_back into +0x44; Clone copies it with 0x5EBF30.

slots_noted: CChangeInvestmentCommand slot 0 (0x556700) and slot 2 (0x557710) are shared with CChangeLeadershipCommand, a two-class fold, and are left unnamed (trap 4); slot 4 (0x556DC0, the existing CChangeInvestmentCommand::LoadKey) is the same fold and is not touched; slot 14 is ReturnTrue.
